rubric: The base moved and the lockfile conflicts with it: a drift from the base, a rebase is the right move.

criteria.class: the base branch moved: a conflict, a stale lockfile or a base commit the change no longer fits

reading.why: A merge conflict in the lockfile after the base moved twelve commits: the base moved under the change.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: real
ruledOut.why: The base moved and the lockfile conflicts. It is not: the change broke a test, a build or a lint rule; a fix in the code is needed.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: flake
ruledOut.why: The base moved and the lockfile conflicts. It is not: a flaky or timing-dependent failure, likely to pass on a re-run.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: infra
ruledOut.why: The base moved and the lockfile conflicts. It is not: the runner, a registry, the network, a quota or a service the job needs failed; nothing in the change can fix it.
